reasonText: The claim documents were received by us on 28/07/2025, i.e. 45 days after the date of discharge (13/06/2025). Intimation of the hospitalisation was also given only on 02/07/2025. Despite our reminder letters dated 09/07/2025 and 18/07/2025, the original final bill and the investigation reports were not submitted within the time allowed. The claim is therefore repudiated for non-submission of documents within 30 days of discharge and late intimation.
